critical_code_review_comments: ai_chat.py: Multi-turn 'replay' loop calls send_message for each prior user turn before sending new message — this incurs extra LLM cost & latency; consider passing history directly via LlmChat history if the SDK supports it, or relying on stored DB state without re-sending.

ai_chat.py: smart_recommendations builds session_id with random suffix per call (reco_{uid}_{secrets}) so context never persists between calls — this is intentional but could be optimized to cache last result for short window to reduce LLM spend.
ai_chat.py: parse_json regex r'\[.*\]' is greedy DOTALL — works but could mis-match if model wraps array in code fences; current fallback covers it gracefully.
Content gen splits on '|||' — if model accidentally outputs nothing then `parts` falls back to single repeated entry (good fallback).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 specified flows (Lottery showcase+modal, AI Chat widget round-trip, Smart Recommendations on home, AI Content Generator with 3 variations) verified end-to-end with real LLM responses

seed_data_creation: A few ai_chat_sessions documents were inserted in MongoDB during chat tests. They are scoped to user_email kunde@bidblitz.com. Test for DELETE /chat/{session_id} cleans up its own session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI endpoints under /api/ai/* require auth via HttpOnly access_token cookie (same pattern as rest of app). LLM calls are slow (5-15s); use timeout >=45s for chat and >=60s for recommendations. Chat session_id pattern is 'chat_<hex>'. The AIChatWidget is mounted globally when authenticated and uses data-testid='ai-chat-fab', 'ai-chat-sheet', 'ai-chat-input', 'ai-chat-send', 'ai-chat-close', 'ai-chat-reset', 'ai-msg-user/assistant'. Lottery prize_pool tiers must include images that are valid http URLs. New /ai/content route at AIContentGeneratorPage uses data-testid 'ai-content-page', 'ai-content-business', 'ai-content-category', 'ai-content-keywords', 'ai-content-tone', 'ai-content-language', 'ai-content-generate', 'ai-content-result-{i}', 'ai-content-copy-{i}'.
